rationale: Professional developers on $200/mo Claude Code plans are a specific, budget-holding buyer with demonstrated pain (529 errors break real coding workflows daily). Willingness to pay is strong: they already spend heavily on AI tooling and multiple paid proxy/reliability services (LiteLLM, Portkey) exist in the space. However, buildability is moderate — a managed multi-provider failover proxy requires backend infrastructure, key management, and reliability SLAs that go beyond a simple Claude prompt + Stripe page; operational_autonomy scores 7 but just misses the build gate of 7 (it hits it exactly, so gates pass), while buildability_with_ai at 6 just meets the floor. Stage is capped at validate because responsiveness_signal is untested and the technical build complexity needs a scoped proof-of-concept before committing.
solution_plan: This is a managed LLM reliability proxy: when your Claude API returns a 529, it automatically retries via a fallback provider (e.g. OpenAI or a secondary Anthropic key) with zero code changes on the customer's end. The factory builds a Claude-assisted configuration wizard + a simple dashboard landing page + Stripe subscription link; actual proxy logic would need a lightweight hosted service (Cloudflare Worker or similar), which the factory can scaffold but the operator would need to deploy to a hosting service (no coding, just a one-click deploy button). Sell to developers active in Claude/Anthropic communities on HN, Reddit r/ClaudeAI, and Twitter/X — outreach drafts go out only after operator approval. Once live, billing runs through Stripe automatically, usage dashboards update via the proxy logs, and support queries are handled by a Claude-powered FAQ bot; the only recurring operator touch is approving new outreach batches. Realistic caveat: hosting and maintaining a live proxy (even a simple one) requires occasional infra check-ins — this is not zero-touch, but it is low-touch.
notes: build_gates: operational_autonomy=7 (meets floor exactly), buildability_with_ai=6 (meets floor exactly), buyer_clarity=8 (passes), willingness_to_pay=7 (passes). All gates pass, but responsiveness_signal is 0 — validate first with a landing page to gauge demand before building the proxy infrastructure.
